# User Guide for This Template

Use this template with Quarto markdown (qmd). For more information on Quarto, visit <https://quarto.org> [here](https://quarto.org/docs/authoring/markdown-basics.html#footnotes).

## Title

The title should be in Title Case. Keep it concise and informative, ideally within 12 words. Avoid abbreviations in the title unless they are widely recognized.

## References

Add your bibliography entries to `ref.bib` and cite them using standard Quarto citation syntax. Here is an example citation on diamond open access [@fuchs2013diamond]. According to @fuchs2013diamond, diamond open access model is amazing.

### Regulations (Peraturan)

Do not cite regulations with `[@key]`. In the text, refer to a regulation by its formal name, e.g., Peraturan Pemerintah (PP) Nomor 28 Tahun 2025 tentang Penyelenggaraan Perizinan Berusaha Berbasis Risiko or Undang-Undang (UU) Nomor 17 Tahun 2003 tentang Keuangan Negara. Then add its `ref.bib` entry and list its key under `nocite` in the YAML header so it appears in the bibliography:

```yaml
nocite: |
  @pp28-2025, @uu17-2003, @permenkeu-key-three
```

Write regulation entries in `ref.bib` as `@misc`, with the issuing body as a corporate author wrapped in double braces (see `pp28-2025` and `uu17-2003` in `ref.bib`).

## Footnotes

Use footnotes sparingly. They should be used for additional information that is not essential to the main text.[^1]

[^1]: This is an example footnote.

## Tables

Use standard markdown tables or Quarto's table syntax. @tbl-example shows an example.

| **Parameter** | **Notation** | **Remarks** |
|---------------|--------------|-------------|
| name | - | engine common identifier |
| manufacture | - | name of the manufacturer |
| bpr | $\lambda$ | bypass ratio |
| pr | - | pressure ratio |
| thrust | $T_0$ | maximum static thrust |

: Example table {#tbl-example}

## Figures

Use standard Quarto figure syntax with `![caption](path){#fig-id width=X%}`. Place images in a `fig/` folder.

## Equations

Use standard LaTeX equation syntax. @eq-cauchy shows an example equation.

$$
\rho\frac{\mathrm{D} \mathbf{u}}{\mathrm{D} t} = - \nabla p + \nabla \cdot \boldsymbol \tau + \rho\,\mathbf{g}
$$ {#eq-cauchy}

# Sections

Organize your paper using standard markdown headings.

Some standard sections are:

- Introduction
- Methods
- Results
- Discussion
- Conclusion

# Acknowledgement {.unnumbered}

Include your acknowledgements in this section.

# Funding Statement {.unnumbered}

When applicable, please specify the funding information for this research.

# Reproducibility Statement {.unnumbered}

**Mandatory section!**

Information on how to reproduce this research, including access to: 1) source code related to the research, 2) source code for the figures, 3) source code/data for the tables when applicable.
